roleContext: B2B SaaS company hiring a Senior PM to own a core product area, lead a cross-functional squad, and drive the roadmap. Reports to the Head of Product.

knockouts.name: Minimum PM experience
knockouts.rule: At least 4 years in a product management role (Associate PM, PM, Senior PM, or Group PM). Project management, program management, or project coordination alone does NOT count.

criteria.name: SaaS background
criteria.lookFor: Hands-on B2B SaaS product experience — subscription products, dashboards, APIs, admin tooling, PLG or sales-led motions. Adjacent B2B tech counts partly; pure consumer or non-software counts little.

criteria.name: Domain fit
criteria.lookFor: Relevance of their industry/problem space to a core B2B SaaS product area — workflow tools, data products, fintech infra, devtools, HR/recruiting tech, martech. Reward directly transferable domain knowledge.

criteria.name: Leadership
criteria.lookFor: Evidence of leading — owning a roadmap end to end, mentoring or managing PMs, running a cross-functional squad (eng/design/data), and driving decisions, not just executing tickets.

criteria.name: Communication
criteria.lookFor: Stakeholder management, writing (PRDs, strategy docs), presenting to leadership, and working across sales/CS/exec. Inferred from scope of stakeholders and any writing/presenting evidence.

criteria.name: Tenure & stability
criteria.lookFor: Reasonable tenure per role (ideally 2+ years), a coherent career story, and no unexplained gaps or rapid job-hopping. Short stints and gaps lower this; steady progression raises it.
